text:
[Council File 26-1329]
Motion (Yaroslavsky - Padilla, et al.) relative to instructing the Department of City Planning, with the assistance of the Department of Building and Safety, and the Bureau of Engineering, to draft an ordinance to utilize the City's authority under State law to establish simplified and expedited processing procedures for eligible new-construction condominium and Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU) condominium projects; and related matters.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Motion asking Planning, with Building and Safety and Engineering, to draft an ordinance creating simplified, expedited processing for new condominium and accessory dwelling unit condominium projects.
